visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A Stack Instead of Repeated Replacing
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The method deletes the pairs () [] {} again and again until nothing changes, copying the string every round. Use a stack instead. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Repeated replacing can take n squared steps and copies the string each time. A stack checks the text in a single pass and also reports the first wrong bracket immediately.
